title: A US Senate investigation led by Senators Warren, Van Hollen, and Blumenthal says some hyperscalers misled the public about AI data centers' costs and benefits (Nik Popli/Time)
summary: Nik Popli / Time: A US Senate investigation led by Senators Warren, Van Hollen, and Blumenthal says some hyperscalers misled the public about AI data centers' costs and benefits — Nik Popli … As the world's biggest technology companies race to build data centers across the country to power an AI boom …
